channel.title: CoolCode Field Notes
channel.description: Practical guides to Canadian public records, weather data, archives and the CoolCode tools.

item.title: How many sockeye returned to the Adams River?
item.description: Read DFO’s estimates for Adams River late-run sockeye, compare four-year cycles and find the viewing information for Tsútswecw Park.

item.title: When is an 18-pack of eggs cheaper than a dozen?
item.description: Multiply the dozen price by 1.5 to compare egg cartons. Work through a Canadian price example, then check what you would actually pay for the number of eggs you need.

item.title: How much time do you need to change from the 555 to the 501 at Carvolth?
item.description: Test the walk from Bay 1 to Bay 3 at Carvolth Exchange. A Langley weekday timetable shows exactly when a five-minute bus delay adds 15 minutes to the connection.

item.title: How early did RV campers book July weekends at Rissers Beach and Graves Island?
item.description: July RV weekend arrivals were booked a median of 95 days ahead at Rissers Beach and 46 at Graves Island. Compare the same arrival days in Nova Scotia’s reservation records.

item.title: Can rent outweigh the nursing tuition difference between Nova Scotia and B.C.?
item.description: Compare Canadian undergraduate nursing tuition in Nova Scotia and British Columbia, then work out how much extra monthly rent would change an eight-month budget.

item.title: Moving to Halifax with a child: which numbers can you use?
item.description: Compare asking and paid rent for a Halifax two-bedroom, then narrow the provincial child-care directory to places that explicitly list infant care.

item.title: How many restaurant locations are there in Langley?
item.description: The June 2026 business counts give two answers for Langley. Follow the Township and City records, then compare the figures with Halifax and Canadian restaurant financial benchmarks.

item.title: Reading the Alderney ferry timetable with JavaScript off
item.description: A Halifax ferry page showed a dated departure time in a browser with JavaScript disabled. Use its saved receipt to work out what 56 kb/s would mean for that page.

item.title: What a Canadian connection in the Offshore Leaks Database means
item.description: Compare Canada’s results across five ICIJ investigations. Follow the difference between a company, an officer and an address using the original records.

item.title: How to check an unfamiliar online store in Canada
item.description: Compare a shop’s domain history, business name and return details before paying. Work through a .ca example using public records.

item.title: What a Canadian phone prefix tells you about a call
item.description: Read an area code, exchange and thousands-block assignment, then decide what you can verify about a caller. Start with a public example that uses seven digits.

item.title: How to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC for an email
item.description: Use a received message to find the domain and selector, inspect their DNS records, and compare them with the receiving mail system’s reported results.

item.title: How to check a foreign-currency card charge
item.description: Compare the Canadian amount on a card statement with a reference rate, then calculate the difference in dollars and percent.

item.title: How to check Langley building permits and development applications
item.description: Find the correct Langley municipality, open the original application and distinguish a permit issue date from the date a tracker first saw it.

item.title: How to find previously released federal ATIP records
item.description: Search completed federal access-to-information summaries, identify the right institution and keep a useful shortlist for requesting the released records.

item.title: How to compare a saved weather forecast with the actual temperature
item.description: Follow one Langley or Halifax forecast hour, check its saved prediction against the airport reading, and understand what missing captures and scores mean.

item.title: Reading the CoolCode tools
item.description: What happened to Oxford’s gigabit coverage, why Tor’s Canadian estimate spiked and what else you can learn from 35 CoolCode tools.

item.title: Finding the dial-up page
item.description: Find dial-up in Statistics Canada’s archived internet surveys and read the original PDF pages. Repeat the search locally with Python, Poppler and SQLite.
